The '''Eamus system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained at least one [[Star/Legends|sun]], and the terrestrial astronomical object [[Eamus 6]] occupied the sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position within the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="TEA" />

When [[Solar flare/Legends|solar flares]] caused devastating [[Groundquake/Legends|quakes]] on Eamus 6 at some point between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] visited the Eamus system on her [[CR90 corvette/Legends|consular starship]], the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], to bring emergency gear and [[Medic/Legends|medical]] supplies to the celestial body's population.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eamus system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
